messages:
ana: Heads-up — our HW partner sent an offline usage dump (S3 bulk) for last quarter but their payloads are missing entitlement_ids and have duplicate event_ids when they retried. We need a safe replay strategy into marketplace-ingest without double-billing or losing entitlements.

sam: Ugh. Any checksum or signing on their side?

maria: They included a manifest with md5 checksums per file, but no per-record signature. The duplicates happen because their uploader retried the same slice with new event_id sometimes.

jordan: For replay we should rely on idempotency key we compute: hash(partner_id + original_event_id + usage_window). If that collides with our existing rows, skip. Also map missing entitlement by matching customer_email -> active_entitlements at that timestamp.

lee: Concern: mapping by email could misassign when customers moved accounts. We need to prefer explicit entitlement IDs when present and otherwise route to reconciliation queue for manual review.

ana: @maria can we ask partner to include original_event_timestamp field? That will help ordering.

maria: Asked — they can add original_event_timestamp in the next export but not retroactively. We need a playbook for existing files.

sam: Proposal: ingest pipeline should do 3 phases
1) Validate file-level checksum and manifest, reject if mismatch.
2) Per-record normalization & idempotency dedupe using computed key.
3) Enrich: if entitlement_id missing -> try deterministic heuristics (account_id, email, billing_customer_id), if ambiguous -> send to backfill/manual queue and mark usage as "pending_entitlement" (non-billable).

jordan: Implemented as pseudo-ops:
```
-- dedupe insert
INSERT INTO marketplace_usage (idempotency_key, partner_id, original_event_id, usage_units, entitlement_id, status)
SELECT k, p, e, u, ent, 'ingested' FROM (SELECT compute_key(...) AS k, ...)
ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING;
```
Mark any rows without entitlement_id as status='pending_entitlement' and emit slack alert + ticket to ops.

lee: How long do we keep 'pending_entitlement' before auto-crediting or expiring? We should pick a window (e.g., 45 days) after which we create a credit if unresolved.

ana: 45 days seems reasonable. Create a scheduled job to reconcile older pending records and trigger partner follow-up. Include audit trail for any auto-credit.

maria: For partner confidence we should also provide them a replay report with counts: ingested, deduped, pending. Add S3 path and manifest checksum for traceability.

sam: Ops runbook items:
- who runs the replay: @jordan to kick off after validation
- dry-run first with `--dry-run` flag to count effects
- runback window: process only events < 90 days old for now

jordan: I'll put up a small utility: `replay_partner_dump --partner x --s3 s3://partner/dumps/2024Q1.tar.gz --dry-run` which will output a CSV with action per record. After dry-run, run without flag. Deploy will be behind feature flag.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: infra/replay-service v1.3 -> staging.

lee: After staging smoke pass, we need an A/B: route 5% of live traffic through replay + reconciliation mode and monitor billing delta charts.

ana: Can someone own partner comms? I'll draft message: explain we'll process files, ask them to add original_event_timestamp and entitlement_id going forward; share replay report. @maria pls review.

maria: Reviewing now. Also adding a template for the CSV report.

sam: Great. Action items summarized:
- jordan: implement idempotency & dry-run utility (ETA 2 days)
- maria: partner comms + report template (ETA EOD)
- lee: reconciliation job + credit policy (ETA 4 days)
- ana: coordinate partner onboarding for improved schema (ETA next week)

ana: Thanks all — let's treat this as P1 for marketplace billing integrity. :white_check_mark:
